hypothesisMarkdown:
## Interpolations of one value are constants Hypothesis

Tracks whose values map alike (opacities above one, clamped), color tracks of one color and lookups of one output were interpolation nodes the graph evaluates each frame; they are constants, and what reads them folds with them.\n\n**Tested mechanism:** constant folding of single-valued interpolations. **Allowed:** `graph.rs` lookup, track, color_track; a new test group. **Forbidden:** plan-side node creation.
